jia: quick hypothesis: HPA is CPU-based and doesn't capture queue backlog. The serving runtime prefers to add pods, but new pods do expensive model download + kv-cache warmup that takes ~30s-90s, during which they don't help. Pool GPUs are saturated so even when pods become ready they can't get scheduled to GPUs quickly. That causes a feedback loop: queue grows -> HPA fires -> warmup slows -> queue grows more.
